annotations.title: Look up a domain's public records

description: Everything public about one domain, wherever it is registered: registry record (registrar, created, expires, statuses, transfer lock, DNSSEC), DNS (nameservers and where it is hosted, A/AAAA, MX, SPF, DMARC, parked for sale), whether HTTPS answers, and the next step: a buy_url for a name with no record, or a transfer_url (and when a transfer becomes possible) for a registered one. No sign-in needed.
name: domain_info
title: Look up a domain's public records
